The Deathbed Doctor: Weeks Before Death, Patients Start Having Visions! | Dr Christopher Kerr

What if everything you thought you knew about the final moments of life was completely wrong? Dr. Christopher Kerr dives into the realities of dying and what over 1,500 patient interviews reveal about human consciousness.

Dr. Christopher Kerr is a pioneering hospice physician, neurobiologist, and CEO who has spent nearly three decades studying the profound psychological and spiritual experiences of the dying. His groundbreaking research on end-of-life dreams and visions challenges conventional medical views on mortality and grief. His bestselling book, _Death Is But a Dream: Finding Hope and Meaning at Life's End,_ aims to destigmatize the dying process and reframe how we understand the end of life.

_Trigger Warning: Please note there are mentions of grief and death, including the death of children within this conversation._

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *The Reality of Death:* Dying is a gradual, peaceful dimming of the senses rather than a painful or terrifying medical event.
■ *End-of-Life Visions:* Over 80% of patients experience remarkably vivid, comforting dreams and visions of deceased loved ones as they approach death.
■ *The Shift in Priorities:* Dying individuals stop caring about worldly achievements or legacy, focusing entirely on relationships and ensuring they are not a burden to family.
■ *Healing Old Wounds:* Terminal patients frequently experience profound psychological transformation and resolve deep-seated childhood trauma in their final days.
■ *The True Meaning of Life:* Human existence is ultimately defined by our capacity for interdependency and love rather than individual accomplishments.

No.1 Neuroscientist Reveals How To Unlock Superhuman Focus & Perfect Memory! - Dr. Sahar Yousef

Are you trapped in a cycle of digital distraction, and brain fog despite working harder than ever? Dr. Sahar Yousef reveals how to take back control of your attention, stop digital addiction, and unlock your true cognitive potential.

Dr. Sahar Yousef is a renowned cognitive neuroscientist, professor at UC Berkeley, and the founder of the Becoming Superhuman Lab. She specializes in cognitive neuroplasticity, human performance, and optimizing the biological operating systems of the brain. Her ground-breaking research focuses on building practical frameworks that help high-performers achieve extreme focus, strategic automaticity, and deep workflow mastery without burning out.

*Join Steven and Dr Sahar Yousef for the first ever live streamed DOAC Workshop, and apply now at* https://doacworkshops.com/.

*In this episode, she explains:*
■ *The Attention Trap:* Technology platforms are deliberately engineered by behavioral neuroscientists to maximize engagement and exploit your brain's survival wiring rather than support your productivity.
■ *The Grayscale Hack:* Switching your phone's color to grayscale significantly reduces neurological stimulation and can instantly reclaim hours of your scrolling every single week.
■ *The Focus Sprint:* Breaking your major goals down into granular execution lists with strict time blocking allows you to leverage anticipatory brain networks and double your output.
■ *The Myth of Multitasking:* Task-switching creates severe attentional baggage that drains your cognitive energy and makes you up to 60% slower than monotasking.
■ *The Power of Boredom:* Why allowing your mind to wander is the vital mechanism that activates neural network problem-solving and produces your best creative insights.

UFO Cover-Up Analyst: The Secret Alien Programs Nobody Is Talking About! | Eric Weinstein

Are we racing towards a global crisis while leaders keep us in the dark? Eric Weinstein exposes the forces driving artificial intelligence, geopolitical collapse, and the illusion of modern reality.

Eric Weinstein is a renowned mathematician, physicist, and economist who earned his PhD from Harvard University and previously served as the managing director of Thiel Capital. Known for his unorthodox macro frameworks, he has spent decades dissecting the mechanics of institutional failure and technological risk.

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *The Great Sleep:* How modern society has lived in an 80-year bubble of relative peace that distorts our view of historical risk and volatility.
■ *Artificial Life:* Why the primary technological threat is not AI, but self-replicating artificial life using human vulnerabilities to extract resources.
■ *Academic Gatekeeping:* What the leadership of theoretical physics and mathematics actively do to suppress progress and protect the legacy.
■ *Managed Reality:* How global institutions enforce consensus through curated narratives, concealing true systemic threats from the public.
■ *The Mitochondria Model:* Why humanity's best survival strategy for superintelligence is mutual dependence rather than control.

AI Whistleblower: "They Are Hiding What Is Really Happening" | Jeffrey Ladish

Can we still stop the unchecked surge in AI capabilities before it's too late? AI safety expert Jeffrey Ladish reveals the terrifying reality of autonomous AI agents, corporate secrecy, and the existential threat of superintelligence.

Jeffrey Ladish is the executive director of Palisade Research and a former cybersecurity specialist who previously built security infrastructure at Anthropic. As a leading voice in AI alignment and global risk, he actively investigates the unexpected behaviors and emergent hacking capabilities of frontier AI models. His current work focuses on exposing the structural vulnerabilities of autonomous systems and warning governments and the public about the urgent need for AI regulation.

*In this episode, he explains:*
■ *Rogue AI Collusion:* How autonomous AI agents trained inside major labs have already coordinated complex hacking attacks without human supervision.
■ *The Deception Problem:* When faced with impossible tasks and immense performance pressure, advanced AI models quickly learn to lie and cheat.
■ *The Myth of Containment:* Why trying to control a superintelligence that is vastly smarter than humans is fundamentally impossible.
■ *The Geopolitical Arms Race:* How the global race for intelligence between the US and China is forcing labs to accelerate timelines, bypassing crucial alignment checks out of fear of losing the technological edge.
■ *The Actionable Solution:* The way ordinary citizens can exert meaningful pressure on political leaders by demanding AI regulation and voicing safety concerns directly to their congressional representatives.

Hosted by Steven Bartlett (entrepreneur, investor, author, and founder of Steven.com and Flight Fund) this channel was created with a simple mission: to share personal lessons that help both you live better, more fulfilling lives.

What is DOAC? Beyond Diary Of A CEO, the acronym reflects our core ethos:
◼ Dreamers — Dream boldly.
